1	/-
2	Copyright (c) 2026 The AlgebraicJacobian authors. All rights reserved.
3	Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
4	-/
5	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic
6	
7	/-!
8	# Local equations for effective Cartier divisors and their Čech Picard class
9	
10	For a scheme `X`, an *effective Cartier divisor* is cut out, locally, by a single
11	regular equation. This file packages this data adapted to the pointed covers of the
12	Čech Picard group (`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic`) and turns it into a Picard class.
13	
14	## Sign / normalization convention
15	
16	A local-equation system `(fᵢ)` for an effective divisor `D` — one regular section `fᵢ`
17	on each member `𝒰 i` of a pointed cover, agreeing up to a unit on overlaps — is the
18	data of a trivialization of the invertible sheaf `𝒪(D)`: on `𝒰 i` the sheaf `𝒪(D)` is
19	trivialized by multiplication by `fᵢ`. The resulting transition units are
20	
21	`g i j = fᵢ / fⱼ ∈ Γ(X, 𝒰 i ⊓ 𝒰 j)ˣ`,
22	
23	i.e. the unique unit with `fᵢ|∩ = g i j · fⱼ|∩`. The class of the corresponding Čech
24	1-cocycle is `𝒪(D)`; this is `Scheme.LocalEquations.picClass`.
25	
26	## Main declarations
27	
28	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocalEquations`: local-equation data for an effective
29	  Cartier divisor adapted to a pointed cover — a regular section on each member, with
30	  the overlap ratios being units.
31	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocalEquations.eqn_restrict_mem_nonZeroDivisors`: the
32	  section-level regularity consequence — every restriction of an equation to a sub-open
33	  is a nonzerodivisor.
34	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocalEquations.ratioUnit`, `ratioUnit_unique`,
35	  `ratioUnit_trans`: the transition units `g i j = fᵢ / fⱼ`, their uniqueness (from
36	  regularity), and the cocycle identity on triple overlaps.
37	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocalEquations.unitsCocycle`,
38	  `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocalEquations.picClass`: the Čech 1-cocycle `g i j` and its
39	  Picard class `𝒪(D)`.
40	-/
41	
42	set_option autoImplicit false
43	
44	universe u
45	
46	open CategoryTheory Opposite CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups
47	
48	namespace CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups
49	
50	/-- Over a poset with binary infima, two 1-cocycles are equal as soon as their values on
51	the binary infima agree. -/
52	private lemma OneCocycle.ext_evInf {P : Type u} [SemilatticeInf P] {I : Type u}
53	    {G : Pᵒᵖ ⥤ GrpCat.{u}} {U : I → P} {γ δ : OneCocycle G U}
54	    (h : ∀ i j, γ.evInf i j = δ.evInf i j) : γ = δ := by
55	  apply OneCocycle.ext
56	  ext i j T a b
57	  rw [OneCochain.ev_eq_evInf, OneCochain.ev_eq_evInf]
58	  exact congrArg _ (h i j)
59	
60	end CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups
61	
62	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
63	
64	namespace Scheme
65	
66	variable {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
67	
68	/-! ## Ring-level restriction helpers -/
69	
70	/-- Restriction of a section along `W ≤ V ≤ U` composes to restriction along `W ≤ U`. -/

1	/-
2	Copyright (c) 2026 The AlgebraicJacobian authors. All rights reserved.
3	Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
4	-/
5	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic
6	
7	/-!
8	# Local equations for effective Cartier divisors and their Čech Picard class
9	
10	For a scheme `X`, an *effective Cartier divisor* is cut out, locally, by a single
11	regular equation. This file packages this data adapted to the pointed covers of the
12	Čech Picard group (`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic`) and turns it into a Picard class.
13	
14	## Sign / normalization convention
15	
16	A local-equation system `(fᵢ)` for an effective divisor `D` — one regular section `fᵢ`
17	on each member `𝒰 i` of a pointed cover, agreeing up to a unit on overlaps — is the
18	data of a trivialization of the invertible sheaf `𝒪(D)`: on `𝒰 i` the sheaf `𝒪(D)` is
19	trivialized by multiplication by `fᵢ`. The resulting transition units are
20	
21	`g i j = fᵢ / fⱼ ∈ Γ(X, 𝒰 i ⊓ 𝒰 j)ˣ`,
22	
23	i.e. the unique unit with `fᵢ|∩ = g i j · fⱼ|∩`. The class of the corresponding Čech
24	1-cocycle is `𝒪(D)`; this is `Scheme.LocalEquations.picClass`.
25	
26	## Main declarations
27	
28	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocalEquations`: local-equation data for an effective
29	  Cartier divisor adapted to a pointed cover — a regular section on each member, with
30	  the overlap ratios being units.
31	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocalEquations.eqn_restrict_mem_nonZeroDivisors`: the
32	  section-level regularity consequence — every restriction of an equation to a sub-open
33	  is a nonzerodivisor.
34	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocalEquations.ratioUnit`, `ratioUnit_unique`,
35	  `ratioUnit_trans`: the transition units `g i j = fᵢ / fⱼ`, their uniqueness (from
36	  regularity), and the cocycle identity on triple overlaps.
37	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocalEquations.unitsCocycle`,
38	  `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocalEquations.picClass`: the Čech 1-cocycle `g i j` and its
39	  Picard class `𝒪(D)`.
40	-/
41	
42	set_option autoImplicit false
43	
44	universe u
45	
46	open CategoryTheory Opposite CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups
47	
48	namespace CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups
49	
50	/-- Over a poset with binary infima, two 1-cocycles are equal as soon as their values on
51	the binary infima agree. -/
52	private lemma OneCocycle.ext_evInf {P : Type u} [SemilatticeInf P] {I : Type u}
53	    {G : Pᵒᵖ ⥤ GrpCat.{u}} {U : I → P} {γ δ : OneCocycle G U}
54	    (h : ∀ i j, γ.evInf i j = δ.evInf i j) : γ = δ := by
55	  apply OneCocycle.ext
56	  ext i j T a b
57	  rw [OneCochain.ev_eq_evInf, OneCochain.ev_eq_evInf]
58	  exact congrArg _ (h i j)
59	
60	end CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups
61	
62	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
63	
64	namespace Scheme
65	
66	variable {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
67	
68	/-! ## Ring-level restriction helpers -/
69	
70	/-- Restriction of a section along `W ≤ V ≤ U` composes to restriction along `W ≤ U`. -/
